Who we are

A Pakistani travel agency with a worldwide reach.

Baba Travels & Tours is a travel agency in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad that books air tickets, Umrah and Hajj packages, northern Pakistan tours, international holidays, visas, hotels, car rental and airport transfers. Travellers get a free quote in about 30 minutes, clear prices in PKR, and 24/7 WhatsApp support from departure to return.

How it works

Booked in four calm steps

  1. 1

    Tell us your plan

    Share dates, budget and travellers through the form or WhatsApp — it takes two minutes.

  2. 2

    Get options in 30 minutes

    A travel advisor sends 2–3 clear options with total prices in PKR, no hidden fees.

  3. 3

    Confirm & pay securely

    Pay by bank transfer, card or mobile wallet. Tickets and vouchers arrive on WhatsApp and email.

  4. 4

    Travel with backup

    A real person answers 24/7 on WhatsApp while you travel, from flight delays to hotel changes.

FAQ

Questions travellers ask us most

Can’t find yours? Ask on WhatsApp — we reply in minutes.

Umrah packages with Baba Travels start from PKR 289,000 per person on a sharing basis for 14 nights, including visa, return flights, hotels and transport. Family and premium packages near the Haram range from PKR 365,000 to PKR 540,000.

Send your dates and number of travellers through our quote form or WhatsApp. An advisor replies with options within 30 minutes during office hours. Once you confirm and pay, tickets and vouchers are sent by WhatsApp and email.

We accept bank transfer, debit and credit cards, JazzCash and Easypaisa. Overseas Pakistanis can pay from the UK, UAE or Saudi Arabia by bank transfer.

Yes. We process UAE, Saudi, Turkey, Malaysia, UK and Schengen visas. UAE visit visas typically take 3–5 working days with complete documents.

April to October. April brings cherry and apricot blossoms, June to September is best for Deosai and high passes, and October has autumn colours.

Yes. Our WhatsApp line is answered 24/7 by a real advisor, and partner desks in Dubai, Jeddah and Istanbul can help on the ground.
